title: A correlated refinement of the double double ramification cycle
summary: Given a family of semi-stable curves together with two degree 0 line bundles, the double double ramification cycle measures the locus where both line bundles are trivial on the fibers. When the two line bundles come equipped with natural roots, we provide a refinement of the DDR-class using the Weil pairing of the roots. We prove that the refined classes satisfy a multiple cover formula analogous to the one for correlated invariants of projective bundles on elliptic curves proved in [BC25b].
